blocking_issues.description: Pre-entry verification per AC-DISPATCH: os.environ.get('BYPASS_QUALITY_GATE') is UNSET in this subagent's process environment. The orchestrator's dispatch prompt included the verbatim env-var directive but did NOT actually set the env-var in the subagent's process. Setting `export BYPASS_QUALITY_GATE=1` inside a Bash tool call does NOT persist across tool calls (each Bash invocation is a fresh shell) and is NOT inherited by the PreToolUse hook subprocess that the harness spawns for Edit/Write tool calls. The hook reads os.environ from the harness's parent process, which was started without this env-var.
blocking_issues.evidence: (1) Bash echo of $BYPASS_QUALITY_GATE returns empty/UNSET on entry. (2) First Edit attempt against scripts/generate-html-interactive.py (3376 lines) blocked by pretool-quality-gate.py with `File has 3416 lines (max 800)` (lines counted from the proposed post-edit content). (3) /root/travel-planner/.claude/hooks/pretool-quality-gate.py:51 implements env-var bypass only; no sentinel-file fallback wired (grep 'sentinel\|dev-registry\|qa.json' = 0 hits).

request_to_orchestrator.summary: Orchestrator must set BYPASS_QUALITY_GATE=1 in the W2 subagent's PROCESS environment (the env passed to the Claude subprocess that runs me), not merely include the directive as inline prompt text.
remediation_options: Option A (env-var, primary mechanism per AC-DISPATCH): orchestrator launches the W2 subagent with BYPASS_QUALITY_GATE=1 in its execve environment (e.g. via env BYPASS_QUALITY_GATE=1 <claude-subagent-cmd>). The current dispatch only included the directive as natural-language prompt text, which the subagent's Bash tool calls cannot propagate to the harness's hook subprocess.

Option B (sentinel-file, alternative mechanism per AC-DISPATCH): orchestrator instructs W1 to extend .claude/hooks/pretool-quality-gate.py to also bypass when a sentinel file exists (e.g. .claude/dev-registry/dev-20260513-090000/bypass-quality-gate.flag). Then create that sentinel before re-dispatching W2.
request_to_orchestrator.post_redispatch_action: On re-entry with BYPASS_QUALITY_GATE=1 actually set (or sentinel file present), W2 will apply 3 surgical edits (Bug 1, 2, 3) to scripts/generate-html-interactive.py per the AC1/AC2/AC3 acceptance criteria and the constraints listed in the dispatch prompt (meals-only alternatives[]; gaode_id fast-path with name fallback; unscheduled-optionals as separate cards section, NOT invented times).

recommendations: OBJ-4 was a major round-2 BA-QA objection precisely about W1->W2 env-var coupling fragility. This block is exactly the failure mode OBJ-4 warned about. The orchestrator dispatch contract specifies BOTH primary (env-var) and alternative (sentinel-file) mechanisms — but only one needs to actually be wired-and-set per cycle. This cycle has the directive in dispatch-prompt text but not in process env, and no sentinel-file fallback was wired by W1.

Long-term fix: future dispatch contracts should encode env-var injection at the harness-launch level (so the subagent's parent process inherits it), or always prefer the sentinel-file mechanism since it survives any shell-level fragility.
